X-Client-Correlation-Id.description: The value supplied in the request's X-Correlation-Id header, returned unchanged. It is never adopted as the flow's identifier (ADR-0034) and reaches no log, span or stored record; it exists so a caller that no longer holds the connection can match a response to a request. Present only when a well-formed value was supplied.

X-Correlation-Id.description: The identifier of this request flow. Quote it when reporting a problem; it is what joins a client report to the record of what happened.

accounts.AccountNotEmpty.description: [409] The account still holds a non-zero balance; empty it and retry.

accounts.AccountOpeningRefused.description: [409] The caller is not eligible to hold accounts; complete verification and retry.

accounts.UnsupportedCurrency.description: [422] The platform does not operate accounts in this currency.

api.Conflict.description: [409] The request conflicts with the current state.

api.Forbidden.description: [403] You do not have permission to do that.

api.IdempotencyInProgress.description: [409] That request is still being processed.

api.IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: [422] This operation requires an idempotency key.

api.InternalError.description: [500] Something went wrong on our side.

api.MalformedRequest.description: [400] The request could not be understood.

api.MethodNotAllowed.description: [405] That method is not allowed here.

api.NotFound.description: [404] The requested resource does not exist.

api.UnsupportedMediaType.description: [415] That media type is not supported.

consent.ConsentRequired.description: [409] No current consent basis exists for this purpose; grant consent and retry.

consent.ReconsentRequired.description: [409] The consent text has changed and requires re-consent; grant against the current version.

consent.UnknownTextVersion.description: [422] No consent text with this version exists for this purpose.

identity.AssuranceRequired.description: [403] This operation requires a stronger authentication.

kyc.CaseNotAcceptingOwners.description: [409] The case is no longer accepting owner declarations.

kyc.NoOpenCase.description: [409] You have no open verification case for this to apply to.

kyc.OwnerAlreadyDeclared.description: [409] This party is already declared on the ownership graph.

kyc.OwnerNotEligible.description: [422] This party cannot be declared as a beneficial owner.

kyc.StakeExceedsWhole.description: [422] The declared stakes would exceed the whole of the organisation.

party.RegistrationRefused.description: [422] This registration could not be completed.

ProblemDetail.description: An RFC 9457 problem detail. Clients switch on `code`; `title` is prose and may be reworded, and several codes share a status. Absent members are absent, never null.

info.description: The public HTTP contract. Versioned in the path (ADR-0015); errors follow RFC 9457, catalogued in docs/architecture/ERROR_CONTRACT.md. Generated from the application on every build and compared against this committed copy, so a change to the contract cannot reach a client without being reviewed.
